step1.title: Generate keys in Razorpay
step1.body: In the Razorpay Dashboard, create a Test key (or a Live key when you go live), and a webhook secret.

step2.title: Put them in config/secrets.env
step2.body: Fill these variables on the server. The file is never committed.

step3.title: Register the webhook
step3.body: Add the webhook URL above in the Razorpay Dashboard with the same webhook secret.

step4.title: Restart the backend
step4.body: The backend reads the secrets file when it starts.

step5.title: Test the connection
step5.body: Use Test connection above. Online payment methods turn on for customers automatically.

gateway.securityNote: For security, Razorpay keys are never typed into, stored by, or shown on this screen. Only whether each key is set, and the key ID masked.
